channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in United Kingdom
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: Win a Trip to New York with Arighi Bianchi x Henbury Travel – Henbury Travel Ltd in partnership with Arighi Bianchi (Macclesfield)
item.description: Prize: 3-night city break to New York for two: return economy flights from Manchester or London, 3 nights in a 4-star hotel and checked luggage (travel based on November 2027 departures). Deadline: January 30, 2027. Complete the entry form on the Arighi Bianchi competition page and say why you would love to win. One standard entry per person; no purchase necessary (orders over £500 give one extra entry). Marketing opt-in is optional. UK residents 18+. Closes 30 January 2027 at 11:59pm; winner drawn at random after closing.

item.title: Fairfax & Favor 12 Days of Christmas Advent Giveaway 2026 – Fairfax & Favor Ltd
item.description: Prize: 12 daily prizes worth over £15,000 in total: 11 sets of Fairfax & Favor products (as gift card/store credit to the value) and a 12th-day «Wishlist» prize (gift card to the value of four chosen items). Deadline: December 12, 2026. Sign up once on the advent page with name and email (mobile optional) between 2 November and 12 December 2026 at 1pm; entering adds you to Fairfax & Favor marketing emails. Everyone who enters by 1 December is in every daily draw from 1 to 12 December (1pm UK time); later sign-ups join the remaining draws. The 12th-day Wishlist prize additionally requires picking four products and emailing the wishlist to another person (optional). No purchase necessary.

item.title: The Getaway Guide: win a Yankee Candle Christmas Countdown Calendar – The Getaway Guide (Sally McMahon)
item.description: Prize: One Yankee Candle Christmas Countdown / Advent gift set with a scented tealight behind each door. Deadline: November 22, 2026. Log into the Gleam widget on the giveaway page and answer the question «What is your favourite thing about December?». Bonus social media entries are optional. Free. UK entrants aged 18+. Closes 11:59pm on Sunday 22 November 2026; winner announced 23 November 2026.

item.title: Kraken: A Christmas Call with Poldi – win a video call with Lukas Podolski – Kraken (Payward Ltd.)
item.description: Prize: Ten winners each get a place on a 30-minute group video call with Lukas Podolski in the week of December 15–19, 2026 (ARV $500 each, $5,000 total). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. One entry per person. 18+ (or age of majority) residing in the EEA, the United States (excl. Maine, New York, Florida, Puerto Rico), Canada (excl. Quebec) and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; residents of the UK, Australia and Switzerland are not eligible. Runs Nov 1 – Dec 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC; 10 winners drawn after the close. Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question.

item.title: South Downs Advent Quiz 2026: win a £100 South Downs Christmas hamper – South Downs National Park
item.description: Prize: A South Downs Christmas hamper worth £100 for the winner; the runner-up gets a bottle of South Downs sparkling wine. Sign up with your email on the South Downs advent calendar page before 1 December, then open the doors and answer the quiz questions. The winner is drawn at random from those with the most correct answers. Free, no purchase. 18+ with a valid email address; signing up includes the National Park newsletter (optional extra newsletter box for more prizes).

item.title: Club Cosmo Twelve Days of Christmas Calendars, Day 1: win the Pandora Holiday Advent Calendar – Hearst UK (Cosmopolitan / Club Cosmo)
item.description: Prize: One winner receives a Pandora Holiday Collection Advent Calendar (exclusive edition, not sold in stores). Deadline: November 22, 2026. Log in as a Club Cosmo member (free to join) and submit the entry form on the competition page. One entry per person. No purchase necessary. UK residents 18+. Closes 11:59pm on 22 November 2026

item.title: Visit Leicester Christmas Giveaway: win one of two Leicester Christmas prize packages – Visit Leicester
item.description: Prize: Two prize packages: «Family Christmas Adventure» (one-night stay for up to four at The Gresham Aparthotel, National Space Centre family annual pass, Beauty and the Beast tickets at De Montfort Hall, museum visits, chocolate workshop, afternoon tea and more) or «Leicester Staycation» (overnight stay with breakfast at The Grand Hotel Leicester, Leicester Tigers tickets, £50 Leicester Gift Card, cinema, afternoon tea and more). Deadline: December 13, 2026. Fill in the 2026 Christmas Competition form on visitleicester.info (name, email, phone, postcode, a few questions, choose your prize package). Free, one entry per person, UK residents 18+. Closes Sunday 13 December 2026

item.title: Cadbury Gifts Direct: win a 12-pack of 90g Advent Calendars – Cadbury Gifts Direct (Hemingways Marketing Services Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One 12-pack of Cadbury 90g Advent Calendars. Deadline: November 25, 2026. Enter on cadburygiftsdirect.co.uk/competition by answering: what day of the week is Day 1 of Advent in 2026? Free. Prize posted within the UK. Closes 23:59 Wed 25 Nov 2026; winner notified by email by 26 Nov

item.title: Win with FALKEN – Bike Giveaway: BULLS e-trail or carbon gravel bikes – SOKRATIV GmbH (with Dunlop Tyre Europe / BULLS / ZEG)
item.description: Prize: 1× BULLS Copperhead EVO AM 2 e-trail bike (RRP €4,999) and 3× BULLS Machete RX 1 carbon gravel bikes (RRP €1,999 each). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the free participation form on win-with-falken.com, select a bike and confirm terms. No purchase of FALKEN tyres required. One entry per person. Open to residents 18+ in Belgium, Bulgaria, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Czech Republic or Hungary. Closes Nov 30, 2026 at 18:00

item.title: Win a Christmas city break in Leeds – Visit Leeds
item.description: Prize: An overnight stay for two at The Queens Hotel, a £100 gift card for Leeds Christmas Market, a £200 Trinity Leeds gift card, two tickets to Northern Lights at Temple Newsam + Veezu taxi, two tickets to the Ice Cube ice rink, dinner for two at The Victoria & Commercial and up to four tickets to Jack and the Beanstalk at The Carriageworks Theatre. Deadline: November 12, 2026. Fyll ut skjemaet på nettsiden. Gratis, 18 år+. Reise ikke inkludert

item.title: Antipodes Black Friday Pre-Access Competition: 3 × £50 store credit – Antipodes Wellness Ltd
item.description: Prize: 3 × £50 Antipodes store credit. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Sign up for Black Friday pre-access with your email (marketing opt-in) on the Antipodes UK site. 18+, no purchase necessary. Oct 30 – Nov 15, 2026

item.title: A2B Christmas Giveaway: Mystery Finds Box + 2 × £100 e-gift cards – A2B (ShopWithA2B, Byron Dittmann)
item.description: Prize: Website quiz draw: a £200 RRP Mystery Finds Box and 2 × £100 A2B e-gift cards. Deadline: December 13, 2026. Take the free Christmas quiz on the A2B giveaway page (the Instagram/Facebook draws are separate and optional). UK residents 18+, no purchase necessary. Oct 26 – Dec 13, 2026 23:59; winners contacted Dec 14

item.title: Coca-Cola Christmas 2026: win Lapland and Disneyland trips (GB) – Coca-Cola Great Britain
item.description: Prize: Instant wins: 4 Lapland trips for a family of 4 (2 adults, 2 under-15s, 5 nights at Santa Claus Holiday Village), 5 VIP and 120 standard Disneyland Paris packages for 4, 3,990 Coca-Cola Christmas toy trucks and bottle e-vouchers; mop-up draw for 10 toy trucks. Deadline: December 21, 2026. In The Coca-Cola Club on the Coca-Cola App: enter pin codes from Coca-Cola packs for points (30 points per instant-win entry). No purchase necessary: call 01756 340310 (9am–5pm, standard rate) for a free code by email. Max 2 entries per day. Residents of England, Scotland and Wales 18+. Instant wins 09:00 2 Nov – 08:59 21 Dec 2026, mop-up draw to 09:00 25 Jan 2027

item.title: My SZN Christmas Prize Draw: 5 × £20 gift cards – My SZN
item.description: Prize: 5 × £20 gift cards. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Create a free My SZN account and Keep or Plan a Christmas item on two different days during the promotion. UK residents, no purchase necessary. Nov 16–30, 2026

item.title: The Formula Christmas Giveaway 2026 – Formula Fragrances
item.description: Prize: Formula Fragrances Complete Collection (discovery box 3×10 ml + 30 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml). Deadline: December 17, 2026. Fill in the free entry form on formulafragrances.co.uk (one entry per person, marketing opt-in optional). UK residents 18+. Winner drawn 18 December 2026.

item.title: Ordo Black Friday Airbnb Giveaway 2026 (UK) – Ordo (Ordoclub Ltd)
item.description: Prize: Six Airbnb gift cards: £1,500, 2 × £500 and 3 × £250 (total £3,250). Deadline: November 29, 2026. Enter via the online form with name and email or mobile; no purchase and no marketing opt-in required. UK residents 18+. 1 Nov 16:00 GMT to 29 Nov 2026 23:59 GMT

item.title: B.E.G. Advent calendar (UK): daily quiz and prize draws – B.E.G. Brück Electronic
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: grand prize Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses; other prizes up to €2,000 incl. Makita DMR112 radios, Apple AirPods 4 and JBL Flip 7 speakers). 2025: from 1 December open the door of the day on beg-luxomat.com, answer the question and collect points for the draws. 2026 details not announced yet

item.title: KILLSTAR Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway: win a £1,000 gift card – KILLSTAR (Draco Distribution Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One £1,000 KILLSTAR gift card for one UK winner (valid 6 months). Deadline: November 22, 2026. Free: sign up for KILLSTAR emails via an official KILLSTAR sign-up form, or email giveaway@killstar.com with the subject "Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway" and your full name. Optional SMS opt-in gives one bonus entry. UK residents 18+. Closes 11:59 pm GMT on 22 November 2026

item.title: SBS Hair Christmas Competition 2026: Samsung 65" 4K TV – Salon Business Solutions (SBS Hair)
item.description: Prize: 1 × Samsung 65" 4K Smart TV. Deadline: December 16, 2026. Complete the official competition entry form. Free, no purchase necessary. UK residents 18+

item.title: Marketsz Major Sweepstake: win an iPhone 18 Pro – Marketsz Inc.
item.description: Prize: One iPhone 18 Pro (ARV $890) plus 1 year of Marketsz membership. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Free entry: create a free Marketsz account to receive ballots, or enter by the free email method described in the official rules. Open worldwide where legal, 18+. Ends December 31, 2026

item.title: Milwaukee Christmas calendar giveaway (10 winners in the UK) – Milwaukee Tool (TTI EMEA Limited)
item.description: Prize: A Milwaukee Christmas Calendar (EU 2026 edition) – 10 winners per participating country. Deadline: November 11, 2026. Subscribe to Milwaukee Heavy Duty News via the pop-up form on the website and confirm your email. Free, no purchase, UK residents 18+. Closes 11 November 2026 at 23:59; winners drawn 18 November

item.title: Tourism Whistler Go Bigger in Whistler Contest (UK) – Tourism Whistler
item.description: Prize: Winter trip for 2 to Whistler, BC: round-trip flights, 6 nights at The Westin Resort & Spa, 3-day Whistler Blackcomb lift tickets and rentals, Dawn Patrol heli-skiing, sightseeing tour, cultural centre and two dinners (approx. CA$14,000 / US$9,838). Travel Dec 2027–Mar 2028. Deadline: May 5, 2027. Register with name, email, phone and country on the contest page; one entry per person, plus one bonus entry for subscribing to the Whistler Insider newsletter. Open to residents of Canada (excl. Quebec), the US (excl. NY, FL, PR), Australia and the UK, age of majority. Closes May 5, 2027, 11:59 AM PST

item.title: Win two tickets to the Hawk Conservancy Trust – Visit Hampshire
item.description: Prize: 2 full-day tickets to the Hawk Conservancy Trust. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Enter via Visit Hampshire's competition page. UK residents 18+ (excl. Channel Islands and Isle of Man). Closes 23:59, 15 November 2026

item.title: IBCC Holiday Prize Draw – Away Resorts
item.description: Prize: One Away Resorts holiday up to £500. Deadline: November 20, 2026. Complete the web form on comp.awayresorts.co.uk. Free, UK residents 18+, one entry. Closes 9:00am, 20 November 2026

item.title: Win a two-night stay at THE PIG-in the wall – Coast Magazine (Kelsey Publishing)
item.description: Prize: Two-night stay with dinner and breakfast for two, valid until 11 March 2027. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry on coastmagazine.co.uk. UK residents 18+. Closes midnight, 30 November 2026

item.title: Win an overnight stay & afternoon tea – The Relais Henley
item.description: Prize: Overnight stay with B&B for two + afternoon tea for two, Henley-on-Thames. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Enter on the hotel's competition page. Closes 30 November 2026

item.title: Korea Tourism Organization "Win a WA! Moment in Seoul" Giveaway – Korea Tourism Organization London Office (prize by Hays Travel)
item.description: Prize: Trip to Seoul for 2: return economy flights from London Heathrow, 4 nights at a 4-star hotel, private airport transfers and one excursion (up to £3,000). Deadline: December 30, 2026. Fill in the entry form on wasouthkorea.co.uk. One entry per person. UK residents 18+. Travel by 30 April 2027

item.title: Golden Ticket: a year of Cornwall days out – Best Days Out Cornwall
item.description: Prize: Golden Ticket: free family entry to Cornwall attractions for a year. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Enter name and email on the page. Closes 31 December 2026; winners drawn 3 January 2027

item.title: Whistlefish x Celtic & Co. Christmas Competition – Whistlefish
item.description: Prize: A £250 Whistlefish voucher, a £250 Celtic & Co. voucher, a Celtic & Co. blanket and two pairs of sheepskin slippers. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the form on the Christmas competition page. Free, one entry per person. UK residents 18+

item.title: Win a £500 holiday voucher – Anchor Bay Holidays
item.description: Prize: £500 voucher for Anchor Bay holiday cottages. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Subscribe to the Anchor Bay Holidays newsletter. Free. Ends 8pm, 31 December 2026

item.title: Win a Sophie Allport Gressingham duck mug – Gressingham Foods (with Sophie Allport)
item.description: Prize: 750 winners each get a Sophie Allport bone-china Gressingham duck mug. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Name, email and a dropdown question on the page. UK residents 18+. Closes 23:59, 31 December 2026

item.title: Vertu Car Giveaway: win a brand-new CUPRA Raval – Vertu Motors
item.description: Prize: A brand-new CUPRA Raval (electric). Deadline: January 4, 2027. Enter your details at vertumotors.com/car-giveaway. Free, UK residents 18+ with a valid UK driving licence. Closes 23:59, 4 January 2027

item.title: The £20K Giveaway Prize Draw – Utility Warehouse
item.description: Prize: £20,000 cash. Deadline: August 31, 2027. Entry via a UW Partner conversation: a UW Partner submits the official UW online application form for you. No purchase necessary, one entry per person. UK residents 18+, not existing UW customers

item.title: mamabella: win the Sephora Favorites Advent Calendar 2026 – mamabella (Victoria Woollaston-Webber)
item.description: Prize: Sephora Favorites Advent Calendar 2026 (RRP £235; opened for filming, products unused). Deadline: November 19, 2026. Subscribe free to the mamabella newsletter (or follow and comment on TikTok as described on the page). UK residents/UK postal address, 18+. Closes 19 Nov 2026, 23:59 UK time

item.title: Brightsun Travel Digital Advent Calendar 2026 – Brightsun Travel (UK) Ltd
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: 12 windows with travel prizes from airline partners, e.g. a chance at a five-star Dubai holiday, flight vouchers, dining experiences and retail vouchers). 2025: visit brightsun.co.uk/win and open that day's window to enter; each window stayed open until 12 December. Full terms on the entry page

item.title: Explore 'Advent'ure Calendar 2026 – Explore Worldwide Ltd
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: 12 daily draws with Explore goodie bags, travel vouchers, hampers and more, plus a grand prize trip for two on Explore's Upgraded Discover Turkey tour, up to £5,000). 2025: open each day's door and fill in the entry form (name and email); each door opened also counts as an entry to the grand draw. UK residents 18+, one entry per person per day, no purchase necessary

item.title: Petplan Advent Calendar 2026 – Petplan (Pet Plan Ltd)
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with pet prizes for dogs, cats, rabbits and their owners). 2025: open each day's door on Petplan's advent calendar page and enter that day's draw, 1–24 December. Free

item.title: Win a family ticket for 4 to Port Lympne Illuminated – The Family Grapevine (West Kent)
item.description: Prize: A family ticket for four to Port Lympne Illuminated. Deadline: November 25, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the page. UK residents 18+

item.title: Win a family ticket for four to The Christmas Cavity Calamity Mini Panto at Penshurst Place – The Family Grapevine (West Kent)
item.description: Prize: A family ticket for four to The Christmas Cavity Calamity Mini Panto at Penshurst Place. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Answer the question in the entry form on the page

item.title: Win a family ticket for four to Elf The Musical at Trinity Theatre – The Family Grapevine (West Kent)
item.description: Prize: A family ticket for four to Elf The Musical at Trinity Theatre, Tunbridge Wells (Sat 12 Dec, 3.30pm). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Answer the question in the entry form on the page

item.title: DFS Advent Calendar 2026 – DFS Furniture
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: 24 prizes, one per day – sofas, furniture and goodies from partner brands such as Ted Baker and Joules). 2025: enter each day's door on the DFS advent calendar page, 1–24 December. DFS says to check back in the run-up to Christmas 2026

item.title: Win £100 to spend at NIPO (Newcastle) – Appetite magazine
item.description: Prize: £100 voucher for food and drink at NIPO, Newcastle Quayside (use by 30 Dec 2026). Deadline: November 13, 2026. Fill in the competition form on the Appetite page. Free. Closing date Friday 13 November 2026; winner drawn at random

item.title: BOLIA competition: win £6,800 to spend at BOLIA – BOLIA A/S
item.description: Prize: £6,800 to spend on BOLIA designs. Deadline: November 19, 2026. Join MyBOLIA for free (name, date of birth, postcode and nearest store) and you are automatically entered in the draw. 18+, UK residents, one registration per email address. 5 October – 19 November 2026, draw on 20 November

item.title: St Catherine's Hospice Christmas Hamper Prize Draw – St Catherine's Hospice (Preston)
item.description: Prize: A Christmas hamper (collect from the hospice near Preston, PR5 5XU). Deadline: November 20, 2026. Free entry: fill in the hospice's hamper prize draw entry form (no lottery ticket needed). 18+, Great Britain residents; prize must be collected in Lostock Hall, Preston. Closes 20 November 2026, 11:59pm

item.title: Your Holiday Concierge Package Perfect Giveaway: Win a White Company Advent Calendar – Your Holiday Concierge (Brewood)
item.description: Prize: The White Company Advent Calendar worth £336. Deadline: November 20, 2026. Complete the online competition form and answer a few short questions about your holiday habits. Free, no booking needed. 18+, UK residents. Closes 20 November 2026, 11:59pm

item.title: Lights4fun reindeer family competition – Lights4fun Ltd
item.description: Prize: A light-up reindeer family worth £384.99. Deadline: November 27, 2026. Enter via the competition form (joins the myLights4fun email club). Free, 18+. Closes 12pm on Friday 27 November 2026

item.title: Elf Watch November Prize Draw (GB) – Dubois Group Ltd (Elf Watch)
item.description: Prize: £1,000 first prize + 10 Elf Watch Season Passes. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Sign up to the free Elf Tracker on elf.watch and invite friends with your link; when 3 friends have started the tracker you are entered. No purchase or app needed, 18+. Closes 29 November 2026 (23:59 UK time)

item.title: Bond It GBX Prize Draw – Seal It Services Ltd (Bond It)
item.description: Prize: 13 prizes: £1,000, £500 and £250 cash plus 10 GBX/Bond It product bundles (~£50 each). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: complete the online entry form (a few optional market research questions). One entry per person, UK residents 18+. Closes 23:59 on 30 November 2026, draw by 7 December

item.title: Win a festive trip for a family of four to Battersea Power Station – Food and Travel Magazine
item.description: Prize: Festive trip for four worth £2,150: one night in a central London hotel plus Chimney Lift Experience, Glide ice rink and Ramses exhibition tickets. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Answer the question and fill in the form on the competition page. See full T&Cs for eligibility

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT
